notes: The valley of Slaughter: the single written The goes to the article on הֲרֵגָה under rule 29's fronting clause, while the earlier גֵיא בֶן הִנֹּם has no article morpheme and takes supplied ones.
The waw of וְלֹא־יֵאָמֵר takes that as the connective the ASV wrote for it, rule 14; no הָיָה stands here to carry a rule 45 frame.
The italic to bury is added, the Hebrew writing only מָקוֹם.
